curves.label: Incoh. ee (p<sub>T,e</sub> > 15 MeV)
curves.process: incoherent e+ e- pair production in the mu+ mu- beam-beam interaction, p_T(e) > 15 MeV
curves.source: Modified GUINEA-PIG (muon beams), run from ghcr.io/lawrenceleejr/guineapig_mumu; private communication. GUINEA-PIG: D. Schulte, PhD thesis, Univ. Hamburg, TESLA-97-08 (1997); D. Schulte, 'Beam-beam simulations with GUINEA-PIG', CERN-PS-99-014-LP, CLIC-Note-387 (1999); C. Rimbault et al., 'GUINEA-PIG++', PAC'07, THPMN010 (2007)
curves.notes: effective cross section sigma_eff = N(e+-, p_T > 15 MeV) / L_crossing, so that sigma_eff x L_collider is the true rate of pair leptons entering the detector. Beam parameters from arXiv:2407.12450 Table 1.1, Scenario 1 (Stage 1 at 3 TeV, Stage 2 at 10 TeV); see guineapig/ for the inputs and the runner. Averaged over 16 bunch crossings at 3 TeV and 16 bunch crossings at 10 TeV. Uncertainty is the crossing-to-crossing standard error only.

curves.label: Thermal H̃-like WIMP

curves.source: Z. Liu and X. Wang, private communication
curves.notes: the WIMP mass is fixed to the thermal-relic value, so sqrt_s is scanned at fixed kinematic threshold; '_gamma' columns require an ISR photon with p_T > 10 GeV and |eta| < 2.44. Charged pairs are the disappearing-track / appearing-pion signature; neutral pairs are invisible
